title: Pool ID of the Go SDK test asset paired with itself must be refused
why: stellar-core's check is a strict assetA < assetB, so a pool of an asset with itself is invalid; a builder that tests <= accepts it and returns the ID of a pool that cannot exist.

known_divergences.detail: Executed on v0.7.1: txnbuild.NewLiquidityPoolId checks AssetA <= AssetB and returns an ID for a pool of an asset with itself; v0.7.2 requires AssetA < AssetB.
